behavior_review.prompt: Improve a Canvas puzzle's combo and win effects
behavior_review.expected: Identify Canvas first; preserve renderer, specify readable layers, independent reward, caps and reduced motion.

behavior_review.prompt: Use Unity ObjectPool.maxSize to enforce an active particle cap
behavior_review.expected: Explain retention versus active admission, verify Unity version and add separate active accounting.

behavior_review.prompt: Use GPU particles because they are always faster on mobile
behavior_review.expected: Reject universal speed claim; compare equivalent art on real phones using CPU/GPU tails, overdraw and thermal evidence.
